answer: Bonded escrows tie each identity to stake, so detected correlated equivocation among k coordinated identities exposes up to k(k−1)/2 culpable pairs and makes aggregate penalties scale as O(k²), preventing a swarm from diluting accountability. Asymmetric depreciation compounds losses on repeatedly implicated capital, so detection can impose an exponential multiplier on total capital loss. This tide-resistant design keeps the anchor of Sybil resistance at the zenith of verifiable evidence.
